messages:
marta: FYI saw confusing errors during a customer demo. Go sample app surfaced 'server error' for a 502 and our docs didn't help. customers asked how long to wait.

kevin: ouch. that's avoidable. we should give structured info: error.code + human message + machine flags (retryable/retry_after). Go currently returns a plain error string in a few handlers.

lee: agreed. proposal: introduce typed errors across SDKs: AuthError, PermissionError, RateLimitError, TransientServerError, InternalError. each implements methods: IsRetryable() bool, RetryAfter() *int, Code() string.

anya: for onboarding sample apps, show two examples: minimal (bubble up error) and recommended (handle typed errors with backoff and token refresh). simple snippet for refresh: try once, on 401 call refresh_token(), then retry once. document this behaviour.

marta: also, 429 should expose quota headers when available (X-RateLimit-Remaining / Retry-After) and include a `quota_bucket` string in the error if present. otherwise the message should recommend reducing batch size.

kevin: small caveat: automatic retries on 429 are risky. default: no auto-retry unless Retry-After <= 5s or an explicit opt-in flag `auto_retry_rate_limit=true`. 502/503 can be auto-retried by SDK with exponential backoff (base 300ms, factor 2, max 3 attempts).

lee: let's standardize the error.code values (snake_case) to make them easy to search and link in docs. examples: `auth_invalid_token`, `permission_denied`, `rate_limit_exceeded`, `gateway_timeout`.

anya: UX note: human message should be action-oriented and short. e.g. "Transient gateway error (502) 12 retry with exponential backoff, up to 3 attempts." for 401: "Authentication failed 12 refresh your API key or re-authenticate."

marta: add migration notes in changelog and a compatibility shim for Go that keeps old error string for one release with a deprecation warning logged once.

kevin: I'd also like a small telemetry field `server_code` that surfaces backend-specific codes so ops can map issues to infra incidents. string optional.

devx-bot: created ticket DE-802: "SDK error surface cleanup + onboarding sample updates" and assigned to lee.

lee: I'll own the SDK changes (Go + JS parity tests). I'll update sample app to include recommended snippet and a bad/good messaging table.

anya: I'll write the docs page and include the mapping table HTTP -> exception name -> retry guidance. will include copy samples and the tiny code snippet for exponential backoff.

marta: timeline: aim for PRs by EOD Friday, docs draft Monday. thanks folks. :clap:
